tactics:
induction l generalizing i j with
  | nil => intro h; simp at h
  | cons a l ih => intro h; cases i with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ n => simp only [List.zipIdx_cons, List.getElem_cons_succ]; rw [ih]; congr 1; omega
induction l generalizing i j <;> intro h <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.zipIdx_cons] <;> omega
induction l generalizing i j <;> intro h <;> cases i <;> simp only [List.zipIdx_cons, List.getElem_cons_succ, List.getElem_cons_zero] at * <;> simp_all <;> omega
